_doc: D58 (documentation/01_diseno/ARRANQUE_Y_LLEGADAS.md): the player's start (founding), the settlement's pull (attraction) and the people who come to join (arrivals). The C4 storyteller adds its own block here. founding (T310, GB/Game/FoundingRules.h): the candidates the screen 'Your people' offers, how many may be picked, the aptitude of their suggested trade (gene -> role) and the kit: the base every clan finds lying around on the first day (fixed + perMember x people) and, only for the clan founded with a party (the player's: shell new ... party <n>, GBSim --party), the extra of its number of people. With 6 people there is no extra: a game without a party is as before.
